title: Brainrot Rap
blurb: The brainrot rap — every Gen Alpha buzzword compressed into a single track. Skibidi, gyatt, rizz, sigma, fanum tax, Ohio: the whole lexicon, delivered with unearned confidence over a beat. It's simultaneously a parody and a genuine artifact of the era. Play it for anyone who wants to understand modern youth slang, then apologise to them afterwards.
origin: A viral track cataloguing the entire Gen Alpha brainrot vocabulary.
